messages:
maria: Heads-up — nightly eval r-20260320 shows a ~12% drop on long_seq_instrset for redwood-3b-q4v2. Repro locally and on a small dedicated cluster. Failing when prompts include long instruction blocks followed by dense continuation. Session id s-9812

anil: ugh. which commit/quant patch? any infra flakiness from the runner?

nightly-bot: nightly-run r-20260320 completed — failures: long_seq_instrset (12% drop). Trace: https://ci.redwood/nightly/r-20260320

maria: commit 9f3e2a2 — this shipped qconfig v2: reordered prefetch math + new slot mask. No infra alerts. I captured a minimal repro that diverges around token 2049.

kevin: I ran the repro w/ deterministic seed. Divergence point consistent: token 2049. Before that outputs match. After that the model starts ignoring the instruction block and emits generic replies.

kevin: quick log snippet from the reproducer (KV debug enabled):
```
# session s-9812 trace
token_idx 2036: kv_prefetch idx=8134 slot=110
token_idx 2040: kv_prefetch idx=8138 slot=114
token_idx 2048: kv_prefetch idx=8146 slot=122 kv_hit=true
token_idx 2049: kv_prefetch idx=8147 slot=123 kv_hit=false  <-- first miss
token_idx 2050: kv_prefetch idx=8148 slot=124 kv_hit=false
```

yasmin: interesting. slot pattern looks continuous then suddenly misses. could be a wrap/alias after the prefetch refactor, or a mismatch between seqnum base and slot mask. did qconfig change N (num slots) or mask logic?

maria: qconfig v2 changed slot_mask from (N-1) to a dynamic mask computed after quant reorder. N unchanged in most models but the mask computation moved out of the hot path. Might be off-by-one when seqnum alignment crosses chunk boundaries.

ingrid: proposed immediate triage steps:
1) run the repro with -DKV_DEBUG_FULL to log raw seqnum->slot mapping for the whole session.
2) revert qconfig to v1 on a dedicated instance to confirm whether regression disappears.
3) bisect commits between 4b77c1 and 9f3e2a2 to isolate the offending change.

kevin: did a quick bisect locally. Regression introduced at 7a4b11a — that commit refactors prefetch index math and centralizes mask calc.

maria: noted. repro + test script is at ./tests/longctx/repro_s9812.py in my PR branch. It streams until 2100 tokens and asserts instruction fidelity.

anil: actionable patch idea: add an explicit guard that computes slot = (seqnum + prefetch_offset) % capacity and then checks slot < capacity; log and fail loudly if not. I can add that and run quick-nightly. Also add a unit test that forces non-power-of-two capacity to catch mask assumptions.

yasmin: good. we should also run quantized kernels with debug symbols (ASAN build) — some asserts are stripped in release and we'll miss mis-indexing UB.

ci-bot: queued quick-nightly job r-quick-2145001 for branch maria/longctx-repro with KV_DEBUG_FULL enabled.

maria: plan: anil to open hotfix PR with guard + test, kevin to run ASAN reproducer and share logs, then run quick-nightly. If quick-nightly passes, promote to full nightly and run the nightly eval suite. tagging @anil @kevin to own this.

kevin: owning the ASAN run, will post logs. If it points to prefetch index overflow, we should revert 7a4b11a until a proper fix lands.

anil: will send PR in ~30m. thanks for the repro, maria. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — will follow up with link to repro run and attach failing prompt examples.

ingrid: also leave a sticky note in the longctx eval dashboard to mark affected runs so retrospective analysis knows which nightly introduced the regression.

maria: ack. updating the issue tracker now with the summary and cross-linking the nightly run.

kevin: quick note — observed similar divergence on a smaller 1.3b quant model with same qconfig change, so likely general to the prefetch refactor, not model-size specific.

maria: alright team, we'll triage today and aim to have a mitigation in staging before EOD.
